newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Orient Power says China JV opens.
newsitem.headline: Orient Power says China JV opens.

text.p: Electronic products designer and manufacturer Orient Power Holdings Ltd said on Monday it had opened its car audio joint venture plant in Najing, China.
The initial investment of the joint venture, including fixed assets and working capital, was US$5.0 million, it said.

The plant is 51 percent owned by Orient Auto Electronic Ltd, a subsidiary of Orient Power. The remaining stake is owned by China Jiangsu Technical Import & Export Corp, a major Chinese state-owned import/export enterprise, it said.

Orient Power would focus on product development, production management and overseas market penetration, while its Chinese partner would mainly be reponsible for the development of the mainland market, it said.
